en: Every one of us trains Pokémon. It's what keeps this family close!
You beat all four of us! We don't see that very often. Here, I'd like you to have this.
A Pokémon that holds it grows stronger faster, though it slows down while it wears it.
We battle as a family, one after another. Have you tried us all yet?
Is the Macho Brace working out? A little training goes a long way.
I'm going to be stronger than Grandma one day. Just you wait!
I've been battling longer than anyone in this house. But you, dear, have a real gift.
